score_details.reason: A major Ethereum upgrade moving into testing reduces technical uncertainty and supports ETH development/utility narratives—positive for ETH-specific demand and developer confidence.

score_details.title: Bitcoin’s dormant supply rises, a behavior seen during previous bear-market bottoming phases
score_details.reason: Rising dormant supply suggests accumulation/less selling pressure and is a commonly-cited on-chain signal for market bottoming—constructive for BTC sentiment and medium-term price prospects.

score_details.title: Spain gives anti-laundering unit power to freeze crypto accounts without a judge
score_details.reason: Expanded AML powers and administrative account freezes increase regulatory enforcement risk and reduce custody/usage certainty in a major EU market—negative for on-chain activity and institutional confidence.

score_details.title: Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody suffers data breach, exposing client information
score_details.reason: Custody-provider data breaches hit institutional trust and onboarding, increasing counterparty and operational risk premiums for crypto services—material negative for institutional adoption and flows.

score_details.title: Bitcoin ETFs are bleeding cash and the Fed is unlikely to help
score_details.reason: ETF outflows are a direct liquidity/flow drain from BTC markets; combined with a hawkish Fed backdrop (no macro liquidity backstop) this strengthens a bearish narrative for crypto prices and institutional demand.

score_details.title: Hong Kong-based crypto trading firm Auros is winding down operations
score_details.reason: The wind-down of a major trading firm can reduce liquidity and market-making capacity in crypto venues, raising execution costs and volatility—negative for orderly markets.

score_details.title: $7 billion of bitcoin options expire Friday, and the biggest bets look starkly different from October
score_details.reason: Large options expiries can drive short-term volatility and directional pressure around key strikes; market-structure flow risk raises near-term execution and gamma-driven move risk for BTC.

score_details.title: Zcash developers want to phase out older privacy system as a precaution against future attacks
score_details.reason: Phasing out an older privacy system forces user migration and short-term on-chain movement of sizeable balances (~$300m), creating technical risk and potential sell pressure; precautionary but lower market-wide relevance.

score_details.title: Over 1,000 Bitcoin miners were tricked into working for a thief by a fake internet route
score_details.reason: A large-scale BGP-style hijack of miners exposes network/operator vulnerabilities and undermines confidence in mining security and continuity—negative for BTC sentiment and perceived network resilience.

score_details.title: Ripple is worth $90 a share to one fund and $300 to another, SEC filings show
score_details.reason: Divergent institutional valuations for XRP reflect idiosyncratic views on legal/regulatory resolution and token economics; limited market-wide impact but relevant to XRP-specific flows and investor sentiment.

score_details.title: Bill to lock up U.S. government bitcoin for 20 years advances to full House
score_details.reason: If enacted, locking up government-held BTC would materially remove supply from circulation and could be a durable bullish structural driver for BTC; political uncertainty tempers relevance but the potential impact is meaningful.
